title: The Drunken Master
description:
[b]Every drink makes you stronger. Every drink brings you closer to the edge.[/b]

The Drunken Master is a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. He brews potions out of the cards he plays, then drinks them. A little Ethanol in the pot and he's Tipsy: stronger, quicker, laughing. A little more and he's Drunk: hitting harder than anyone in the Spire, but every card in his hand costs whatever it feels like this turn. Push past that and the lights go out. Blackout plays your deck for you, then dumps you into the next turn Hungover, down an Energy and a card, with the enemy still standing there.

Sober is when you brew. Drunk is when you spend. Knowing when to stop is the whole game.

[previewyoutube=Cja3ikogDT8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The dial[/h2]
Intoxication is the dial above the character. It starts every combat at 3, climbs when you drink Ethanol, and resets when combat ends. Some cards cost Intoxication instead of Energy.
[list]
[*] [b]Sober[/b] (0 to 3): no bonus, and the dial holds where it is. This is where you brew. Several cards only work here.
[*] [b]Tipsy[/b] (4 to 7): 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. Fades by 1 each turn.
[*] [b]Drunk[/b] (8 to 11): 2 Strength and -1 Dexterity, and every card in your hand is dealt a random cost from 0 to 3 each turn. Fades by 2 each turn.
[*] [b]Blackout[/b] (12): at the end of your turn, the top 3 cards of your draw pile play themselves. Intoxication drops to 0 and you wake up Hungover.
[*] [b]Hungover[/b]: next turn, 1 less Energy and 1 fewer card drawn. Some cards hit harder while you are Hungover.
[/list]

[h2]Brewing[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ingredient[/b] cards do not resolve when played. They go into your [b]Brew[/b] instead. There are 12 kinds, and cards, relics and potions can create them.
[*] The Brew holds 3 Ingredients (some powers change that). When the third one lands, the pot seals into a [b]Concoction[/b]: a potion that does all three effects at once.
[*] Drink it now or hold it. A Concoction you have not drunk vanishes when combat ends, and so does whatever is still in the pot.
[*] [b]Ethanol[/b] is the Ingredient that gets you drunk. A Concoction containing it grants Intoxication when drunk. Drinking any other potion grants nothing.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=7oFcRhgGfo4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Other keywords[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Poised[/b]: this card's cost is never randomized by being Drunk.
[*] [b]Confusion[/b]: an enemy debuff. Each hit of that enemy's attacks deals 1 less damage per stack, and the damage removed is dealt to the enemy instead. Wears off at the end of its turn.
[/list]

[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] 80 class cards (20 Common, 35 Uncommon, 25 Rare) plus 12 Ingredients
[*] 9 relics and 3 character potions
[*] Custom card, relic and character art, energy gem and character select screen
[*] Works in co-op as long as every player runs the same mod version
[/list]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url] (subscribe to it too)
[*] The [b]public-beta[/b] branch of the game, v0.111.0 or newer. The mod is built against the beta API and will not load on the current main branch (v0.107.1). In Steam: right-click Slay the Spire 2 > Properties > Betas > public-beta.
[/list]

[h2]Status[/h2]
Early release. Balance is still being tuned, and a few UI pieces (rest site and merchant animations, some icons) are placeholders. Feedback and bug reports are welcome in the comments.
changeNote: Bug fix: Hungover no longer stacks. With Blackout Form, or any two Blackouts on consecutive turns, each Blackout added another stack of Hungover and the debuff never wore off, so after a few turns you drew no cards and gained no Energy. A Blackout that resolves while you are already Hungover now just refreshes it for one more turn: always 1 less Energy and 1 fewer card next turn, never more. No balance changes.
